description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that can output log data to various targets and optionally chain multiple loggers together.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output log data and be chained with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message including its priority, tag, message content, and optional Throwable.
